verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework, and a framework could plausibly ship a natural-language command interface, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only agent-readiness aids for external coding agents: a scaffolded AGENTS.md, Markdown docs, /llms-full.txt and portable authoring rules. These are adjacent features, not the product itself accepting natural-language commands. Its CLI (proa new, proa ui add, proa fmt) is driven by conventional commands only.
